crowd.line: Analysts lean cautious: 1 bullish · 3 neutral · 2 bearish
crowd.vs_dashboard: Agrees with the dashboard's Cautious regime

items.name: glassnode
items.takeaway: Every burst of loss-selling since August landed at a local bottom; if the pattern holds, last week's selling just above $80k would mark the floor.

items.name: CryptoQuant.com
items.takeaway: Only 4.4% of 6–12 month old coins that moved went to exchanges: people who bought high have mostly stopped selling, but new buyers haven't shown up yet.

items.name: Darkfost
items.takeaway: After the rejection near $87,000, BTC fell back below the 30th percentile of its MVRV history: out of deep-value territory, but still what they call an accumulation zone.

items.name: Axel 💎🙌 Adler Jr
items.takeaway: Spot BTC ETFs had a second straight week of net outflows; the 30-day total is still positive but shrinking, though the weekly outflow got smaller.

items.name: CoinGlass
items.takeaway: The 48-hour liquidation heatmap shows the densest leverage clusters at $82.3K above and $80.6K below, flagged as price magnets either way.

items.name: ecoinometrics
items.takeaway: Their score of Fed minutes reads firmly hawkish and has climbed since March; they see no quick return to easier policy and call that bad for Bitcoin.
